name: ConciergeItineraryBuilder
tagline: Every guest's stay, planned to the minute – bookings, vendors, confirmations and itineraries in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete hotel concierge module: build each guest's itinerary from restaurant, spa, tour, transfer, theatre, golf and boat bookings, see the whole day in a planner, catch overlaps with a travel buffer and bookings outside the stay, send requests to vendors and chase them, confirm with the confirmation number, get the Chef concierge's approval for high-spend bookings, watch free-cancellation deadlines and fees, and send confirmations and a day-by-day itinerary to the guest – with front desk, concierge and Chef concierge roles. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Guest itineraries day by day with free days and arrival / departure
Day planner timeline per guest with overlap highlighting
Overlap check with a configurable travel buffer; stay-window rule (transfers excepted)
Requested → Pending vendor → Confirmed → Completed; waitlist, cancel, no-show
Confirmation number and start time required to confirm
Chef concierge approval above the approval threshold
Free-cancellation deadlines, fees after the deadline
Vendor chase reminders and urgent unconfirmed bookings
Confirmation message and itinerary text for e-mail / SMS (ConfirmationText, ItineraryText)
Edit stay updates every booking of the guest
Roles: front desk agent, concierge, Chef concierge
Undo, CSV export, bulk actions, Power Fx outputs and events (SummaryJson)
